en_title: Quentin Tarantino Says He's 'Written a Script' for 10th and Final Film, But He Wants to 'Live' Before Making It
cn_title: 昆汀称终作已有剧本，开拍前想先生活
subtitle: 先看看自己想做什么
opus_summary: 昆汀确认已为第10部、也是最后一部电影写好剧本，但想先完成舞台剧、陪伴家人，再生活一段时间。之后他才会决定想做什么，新片何时开拍、上映仍有待观察。

paragraphs.en: Quentin Tarantino has confirmed he's "written a script" for his 10th and final film, but he's going to "live" a little before making it.
paragraphs.cn: 昆汀·塔伦蒂诺确认，他已经为自己的第10部、也是最后一部电影「写好了剧本」，但在开拍前，他想先「生活」一段时间。

paragraphs.en: The Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood and Kill Bill filmmaker teased his plans for his long-in-development finale movie during an appearance on The Graham Norton Show . He said he has a script for a film he "could" do, and it's one he also happens to "really, really like," but he's got a checklist of things to take care of before diving into it.
paragraphs.cn: 这位《好莱坞往事》和《杀死比尔》的导演在参加《格拉汉姆·诺顿秀》时，透露了自己筹备已久的收官之作的计划。他表示，手上有一个「可以」拍成电影的剧本，而且自己「非常、非常喜欢」，但在投入拍摄之前，他还有一连串事情要处理。

paragraphs.en: "I've written a script that I could do that I really, really like, but I have to do the play and see who I am, right?" Tarantino said, referencing his upcoming West End play, The Popinjay Cavalier.
paragraphs.cn: 「我写好了一个可以拍的剧本，我非常、非常喜欢，但我得先把舞台剧做完，看看自己到时候是什么样，对吧？」昆汀说。他指的是即将在伦敦西区上演的舞台剧《The Popinjay Cavalier》。

paragraphs.en: "I'll finish the play, and then I'll go back, be with my family for a while, and then live and then see what that guy wants to do."
paragraphs.cn: 「我会先完成舞台剧，然后回去陪家人一阵子，再过过日子，看看那时的自己想做什么。」

paragraphs.en: The director's words were in response to a question from show host Graham Norton, who asked about his "10th" and "final film." Tarantino didn't skip a beat when conjuring up his reply, suggesting that, yes, the plan is still for his next film to be his last whenever it does eventually hit screens.
paragraphs.cn: 昆汀这番话是在回答主持人格拉汉姆·诺顿的问题，后者问起了他的「第10部」和「最后一部电影」。昆汀毫不迟疑地作出了回答，看来，无论下一部电影最终何时上映，他仍计划将其作为自己的收官之作。

paragraphs.en: For reference, The Popinjay Cavalier is set to start previews February 23, 2027, and then open one month later, March 18. That means we've got some waiting to do before Tarantino will begin the "then live" phase of his pre-movie plan. How long it will be before he then decides on a script, begins production, and settles on a release date remains to be seen, but don't expect to hear any significant updates for a while.
paragraphs.cn: 作为参考，《The Popinjay Cavalier》定于2027年2月23日开始预演，再于一个月后的3月18日正式开演。因此，距离昆汀进入开拍前计划中的「再过过日子」阶段，我们还得等上一阵。至于此后他还要多久才能选定剧本、开始制作并确定上映日期，目前仍有待观察，但短期内别指望听到什么重大进展。

paragraphs.en: Tarantino mentioned wanting to finish his career as a movie director at film number 10 a few years before the release of his eighth film, The Hateful Eight , in 2014. As Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood came and went as his ninth project in 2019, his decision to put a cap on his big-screen presence has only become more controversial amongst fans.
paragraphs.cn: 2014年，距离第8部电影《八恶人》上映还有几年时，昆汀就曾提到，希望在拍完第10部电影后结束自己的电影导演生涯。随着他的第9部作品《好莱坞往事》于2019年上映、下映，他为自己的大银幕创作生涯设定上限的决定，在影迷中引发了更大的争议。

paragraphs.en: A filmmaker with a very specific number of trend-setters – including Pulp Fiction , Inglourious Basterds , and Django Unchained – the idea of intentionally ending his time as an artist has been deemed confusing and disappointing. That doesn't seem to have phased Tarantino one bit, and the time it's taken for him to get started on the final project suggests he's not in any rush to get started.
paragraphs.cn: 昆汀拍过《低俗小说》《无耻混蛋》和《被解救的姜戈》等引领潮流的作品，却为自己的作品数量划定了明确上限。这样一位电影人打算主动结束艺术创作生涯，让人感到困惑和失望。不过，昆汀似乎丝毫没有因此动摇，而收官之作迟迟没有启动，也表明他并不急于动手。

paragraphs.en: Rumors surrounding his enigmatic 10th once had moviegoers expecting him to direct what Simon Pegg called a "bats**t crazy" Star Trek film before the director eventually debunked those alleged plans himself . He was also once said to be making a project called The Movie Critic before it, too, was scrapped .
paragraphs.cn: 围绕这部神秘的第10作，曾有传闻让影迷以为昆汀会执导一部《星际迷航》电影，西蒙·佩吉形容它「疯狂至极」，但昆汀最终亲自否认了这些所谓的计划。他也曾被传将拍摄一部名为《影评人》的作品，但这个项目后来同样被取消了。

paragraphs.en: It will be some time before Tarantino directs another movie for theaters, but that doesn't mean an opportunity to see his work on the big screen is too far away. The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth , a Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood follow-up written by Tarantino and directed by David Fincher , will premiere next month .
paragraphs.cn: 距离昆汀再次执导院线电影还要等上一段时间，但这不代表在大银幕上看到他作品的机会遥遥无期。由昆汀编剧、大卫·芬奇执导的《好莱坞往事》后续作品《The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth》，将于下个月首映。
